On: new content is added after the template’s text; placeholders such as {{TITLE}} and {{BODY}} are still filled in. Off: the template’s body text is replaced (a {{BODY}} placeholder is always filled in place).
On: new slides are added after the template’s slides. Off: the template’s slides are replaced.
On: new sheets are added after the template’s sheets. Off: the template’s sheets are replaced.
